turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
What happened next?
My father used to bet on horses and my mother never forgave him.
What went through your mind then?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
How did that feel for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
And how was that for you?
My son Arjun turns eight on the thirtieth of January and I cannot afford the party.
Take your time.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. It is not easy to talk about.
What went through your mind then?
I deleted three betting apps on Sunday but reinstalled one on Tuesday.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. I think so, yes.
What happened next?
Meera asked about the savings and I said we are saving for a new kitchen.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. It is not easy to talk about.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
